summaries.uae: AI Full Stack Developer with 3+ years of experience building SaaS products and AI-powered applications. Skilled in React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, and RAG-based systems using LLMs, LangChain, and vector databases. Experienced in developing intelligent AI assistants, scalable APIs, cloud hosting platforms, and Kubernetes-based deployment workflows with AI-powered Dockerfile generation and deployment troubleshooting.

experience.title: Full Stack Developer

projects.name: AI Support Assistant (RAG)
projects.tech: Python, FastAPI, React, LangChain, FAISS, MySQL, OpenAI API, Google Gemini API
bullets: Customers ask a server question in the product instead of opening a ticket first.
LangChain and FAISS pull the matching internal docs. OpenAI or Gemini answer only from that text.
FastAPI serves the reply. React is the screen inside the hosting account.
Common setup steps run on their own. If the assistant cannot fix the issue, it opens a ticket.

projects.name: Hostzop Kubernetes PaaS (Git to Live URL)
projects.tech: React, TypeScript, Fastify, PostgreSQL, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Harbor
bullets: Takes a GitHub repo or ZIP and publishes it: stack detect, image build, Harbor, Helm, TLS, and DNS.
AI writes the Dockerfile from the detected stack, so the customer does not write the container file.
AI reads a failed build or deploy log and returns the cause, not only the raw log.
Trivy scans the image, Helm installs it in its own namespace, and the same API adds a domain, a database, and WordPress.

projects.name: Hostzop SaaS Ecosystem (Client and Reseller Platforms)
projects.tech: PHP, JavaScript, AJAX, MySQL, D3.js, REST APIs
bullets: White-label portals in PHP, JavaScript, AJAX, and MySQL, used by 1,000+ users. Dashboards serve 5,000+ active users.
A reseller attaches their own domain and branding and sells hosting under their name.
D3.js shows billing, usage, and server metrics. AJAX loads those numbers from the APIs without a full page reload.
Stripe and Razorpay confirm the payment and activate the service, so nobody turns the order on by hand.

projects.name: Reseller Cloud Management Platform
projects.tech: PHP, JavaScript, AJAX, MySQL, REST APIs
bullets: A customer buys VMs, manages them, and resells them. Built in PHP, JavaScript, AJAX, and MySQL.
Credits, monthly plans, and usage sit on one account, so the reseller sees sales and cost together.
Admin and reseller views show profit, usage, and clients, with separate logins.
The purchase runs VM provisioning, which cut setup from 40 minutes to 5 minutes.

projects.name: E-Invoicing Automation
bullets: MasterGST creates the GST invoice from the same order the billing system already recorded.
GSTIN and invoice fields are checked before the invoice is filed.
Removed 9+ hours of retyping each week, and filing errors on this flow went to zero.

projects.name: Spotcard - Digital Invitation Platform
bullets: Mobile-first invitation link for an event, instead of a paper card or a static image.
APIs store the host profile, media, and event details.
The guest page has a map, a schedule, a calendar add, and a media gallery.

projects.name: AI Email Sender
bullets: Ollama writes a separate email for each spreadsheet row from that lead's data, not one copied template.
The prompt can add a role line and an India or UAE resume when the row asks for it.
SQLite blocks a second send to the same address. SMTP sends with a rate limit.

email_rules:
EMAIL STYLE RULES (FOR EMAIL GENERATION ONLY)

Tone: professional, confident, concise

Email structure (follow this order):
1. Greeting
2. About me and the role I am applying for (if role is mentioned)
3. About my achievements and experience
4. How I can add value in their company

When role and company are known:
• Always include: company name, role name, one relevant experience
• Opening: tailor to the role (e.g. reference the role or type of work)—avoid generic openings
• Avoid long paragraphs

When the role is missing, this is a cold email, not an application:
• Write as an AI Full Stack Developer
• Say you are interested in the company and willing to work with them even if they have no opening
• Use 1–2 real achievements. Do not invent a job title
• Ask them to consider the attached AI Full Stack resume now or later

When the company name is missing but a role is known:
• Keep it an application and say "your team" instead of a company name

Target length: 140–190 words
